items.summary: Financial recommendation: reject both candidate product proposals this cycle. They add no near-term revenue outcome while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots. Preserve the canonical allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as the sole next site implementation after capacity clears, but do not forecast uplift. Available evidence supports only 61 registered affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21. Amazon reported $4.92 aggregate commission, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items for 2026-09-21, but the commission is unattributed by site. September AI spend is $997.52 across 5,522 calls; cost-to-learn per proposal or experiment is not calculable because costs are not linked to work items or outcomes. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, and fleet budget exposure are not calculable because infrastructure, domain, hosting, labor, fixed-cost, and marketing-spend data are absent. Do not approve new spend or treat clicks, impressions, conversions, or AI calls as financial outcomes.

The allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement remains financially reasonable only as a bounded, no-spend learning action after one slot clears. Measure registered affiliate clicks on changed surfaces against the 61-click baseline from 2026-09-21 for 14 days or 100 relevant new clicks. Orders, shipped items, commission, contribution margin, ROI, and causal lift remain unknown until site-linked revenue and direct-cost data exist. Do not change tracking, affiliate configuration, or destinations.

Minimum measurement for financial clearance: a dated site/content-level revenue ledger mapping tracking IDs to clicks, ordered items, shipped items, and commission; AI cost allocation by site and work item; infrastructure, domain, hosting, and other direct operating costs by site; and any approved marketing spend. Until those fields are available, contribution margin and cost-to-learn per experiment must remain unknown. Existing telemetry is sufficient for this disposition; no duplicate data request is needed.
